text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet reacts with alarm to the news that Vodka will be going abroad to train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Left behind in Japan, Daiwa Scarlet reflects on her time with her now-absent rival…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And renews her commitment to becoming number one.
